text:
vivian: RC candidate created: rc-20260310-3 (image@sha256:abc123def456...). Origination PR merged. Requesting promo slot for TOMORROW 10:00 PT. Artifacts pinned, db-migration flag OFF. Please ack roll criteria and any known blockers.

deploy-bot: [bot] rc-20260310-3 recorded. Deploy link: https://deploy.internal/release/rc-20260310-3 :robot_face:
  Commands: `deployctl pin rc-20260310-3 --env prod` `deployctl show-artifact --id abc123def456`

gabe: quick check — smoke suite on staging shows 3/50 flaky asserts in embeddings-service. Unclear if regression or noise. Re-running smoke now.

vivian: thanks gabe. Re-run started. If smoke is green we can move forward. @sheriff-ops will you take post-promo watch?

sheriff-ops: I can cover 10:00–10:30 PT. Will watch latency, error spikes and KV warm metrics. Notify me if we do a partial cohort.

anika: release notes updated and pushed to the docs site. No customer-impacting changes beyond model update notes. :white_check_mark:

kevin: infra question — do we need KV-warm and minibatch pre-warm? If yes, we need a 10 minute window before promo to run warming jobs.

infra-bot: KV warm job scheduled for rc-20260310-3 at 09:50 PT (10m before requested promo). Job id: kvwarm-789.

vivian: good. Blocking promotion until smoke pass + kvwarm complete. Rollback criteria set in the promo notes: p50 latency increase > 20% sustained for 5m OR error rate > 0.5% for 3m, or any customer-facing 5xxs. Rollback playbook: `deployctl rollback --to stable --reason "rc-20260310-3 instability"` and page on-call.

gabe: smoke run finished — embedding asserts are now 0/50. Looks like transient. All smoke checks passed.

vivian: ack. infra-bot, confirm KV warm done?

infra-bot: kvwarm-789 completed successfully (duration 6m). KV hit ratio warmed from 0% to 88%.

vivian: excellent. I'm giving tentative greenlight. Final ask: ops approvals in thread and confirm no last-minute DB flags.

anika: approved for promo from docs side. No migrations.

kevin: infra approved. We'll monitor OOM and node CPU during first 30m.

sheriff-ops: approved. I'm on-call, will escalate per rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: deploy window open. Scheduling promo for 10:00 PT. Will perform canary at 10% for 5m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Automated rollback trigger connected to telemetry gates.

vivian: noted: canary plan accepted. Reminder to update changelog with the pinned artifact digest before promo.

gabe: small note — if we observe model output deltas, we should enable safefall to lower model-temp for affected routes (runbook: `/ops set-safefall rc-20260310-3 --routes "chat*" --temp 0.4`).

vivian: added safefall option to runbook. All checks complete. Proceeding to schedule: promo queue entry set for 10:00 PT. If any of you see unexpected telemetry at promo, call the rollback.

deploy-bot: promo queued — ETA 10:00 PT. Steps: 1) canary 10% (5m) 2) ramp 50% (10m) 3) full (2m lift). Rollback hook: `webhook://ops/rollback-trigger` tied to alert thresholds.

kevin: logging note: enable extended traces for 15m post-promo (`obsctl set-trace-level --service embeddings-service --level verbose --duration 15m`). I'll enable at 09:58 PT.

vivian: final confirmation from everyone?

anika: 👍

gabe: 👍 smoke green

sheriff-ops: 👍 on-call, will take post-promo watch

vivian: thanks team. I'll kick promo when clock hits 10:00 PT unless someone posts blocker.

deploy-bot: deploy started at 10:00:02 PT. Canary at 10% in progress.

deploy-bot: canary checks passed at 10:06 PT. Ramping to 50%.

infra-bot: telemetry: p50 latency stable (within 5%), errors at 0.08%. No action.

kevin: traces on, watching resource metrics. No abnormal memory growth seen.

deploy-bot: 50% hold complete. Proceeding to full roll at 10:18 PT.

deploy-bot: full rollout complete at 10:21 PT. All checks nominal.

vivian: promoting to prod finished. Closing the RC thread and updating release notes with final artifact digest. Thanks all.

sheriff-ops: post-promo note: monitoring window clear at 10:50 PT. No anomalies. Marking RC as promoted/stable. :party-parrot:
